summary: Mencke is a family farm in Barger-Compascuum, Drenthe, Netherlands, that breeds and selects starch potato varieties and grows seed potatoes. It became Mencke Landbouw B.V. in 2012, when Berend Mencke took it over. It is a member-breeder for Averis and represents the German variety NOVANO in the Netherlands.
